subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Should this issue remain the broad v2026.6.11 all-channel incident tracker until the open shared session-conflict and replay-storm PRs plus stable-package proof are correlated, or should maintainers split it under narrower canonical issues now?
rationale: The issue overlaps several source-proven and live-reported slices, but no single merged change currently proves the whole WebChat plus WhatsApp one-exchange/silence/duplicate-reply incident is fixed; choosing the tracking boundary is maintainer incident triage rather than a narrow code judgment.

options.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365, and the next stable package are correlated against the same symptom set.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Move the reply-init, WebChat/heartbeat, WhatsApp replay, and release-package pieces into existing narrower issues and close this only after each piece has a named owner and proof target.

options.title: Treat As Package Parity Only
options.body: Close under the stable-package parity family only if maintainers decide the reply-session package fix fully explains the duplicate and all-channel silence behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365, and the next stable package are correlated against the same symptom set.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision crosses release/package proof and current-source session/recovery routing, and this person is tied to the beta package verification plus current central-source history in this review.
